standard_title: Polyvinyl chloride insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables/cords with rigid and flexible conductor for rated voltages up to and including 1 100 V
information: BIS lists IS 694:2010 for PVC insulated cables/cords with rigid and flexible conductors for rated voltages up to and including 1100 V. The BIS standard details identify this standard as Mandatory Certification.
compliance_checklist: Confirm that the product falls within the scope of IS 694:2010.
Review the applicable Indian Standard requirements for the product.
Review the applicable BIS product manual and Scheme of Inspection and Testing.
Ensure appropriate manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, quality control and testing capabilities are available.
Check the applicable BIS certification and testing process before applying.
